Nick — 1/12/22, 3:15 PMWednesday, January 12, 2022 at 3:15 PMHi everyone, this channel will be for announcements regarding the time trial section of the server. 

We'll be using this channel to announce the world records for the previous tour and introduce the next time trials for this tour. So we'd like to congratulate the following players:

- DIT and @nekozuki tied for the SNES Vanilla Lake 1 World Record with a time of 0:34.20. This is @nekozuki's 1st world record and DIT's 6th world record!
- @Phillish has the 3DS Cheep Cheep Lagoon R World Record with a time of 1:17.03. This is @Phillish's 1st world record!
- @えなが has the N64 Kalimari Desert World Record with a time of 1:14.88. This is @えなが's 47th world record!

This tour's time trials features the return of DS Waluigi Pinball Reverse and the newest track to Mario Kart Tour, Singapore Speedway! The previous World Record was held by @SuperFX with a time of 1:45.91. Here is a video of the lines by Tomegome:

https://twitter.com/tomegome_g/status/1272014555258818560?s=19

Additionally, we have made the ⁠world-champions-profiles and ⁠wr-history public again, so you can see who has recieved a WR and what the times are. Additionally we are planning to bring back the top 10 leaderboard, as we now have an automated system to get that information (thank you @Jimmy). The top 10 for last tour will be released very soon.


We have more exciting announcements for the future. If you would like to give feedback to updates like this, please let the Challenge Updaters and myself know for the future. 

- Tea and the @Challenges Updater Team (edited)Wednesday, January 12, 2022 at 3:15 PMとめごめ🍵 (@tomegome_g)https://t.co/dIwCzk0nmcTwitter•6/13/20, 8:54 PM64Add Reaction

announcementFinding: The January 12 announcement calls the later 0:34.20 tie nekozuki’s first WR. It does not endorse the 0:34.30 personal best as a WR.
